text: Jester is a generic character found in Vulkhel Guard during the Jester's Festival. He is joggling in the middle of the crowd of Festival Merrymakers. He cannot be interacted with.
Jena Matius is an Imperial citizen of the Town and the wife of the woodcutter Varro Matius in .
Jerboa are small rodent-like creatures found in Northern Elsweyr. They do not have any attacks and tend to flee on sight. When killed, they usually drop guts, which can be used in fishing.
Jasaii is an Argonian member of the Bright-Throat Tribe found at Tree-Minder Pavu's House in Bright-Throat Village, Murkmire.
Jarl Reddharn is a Nord and the Jarl of Morthal. After main quest The Gray Host he is residing in the Blue Palace in Solitude.
Jarl Olfwenn is the Nord Jarl of Karthwatch who is encountered as a Harrowfiend during the quest "Danger in the Holds" in .
Jeraud Panitte is a Breton patrolling Northern High Rock Gate, Cyrodiil in .
Jasudei is an Argonian at The Lusty Argonian Footman inn located in Lilmoth.
Jeer-Xu is an Argonian commoner found in Marshland Market in Lilmoth. She has no unique dialogue.
Jarl Hagridden is a Nord who appears as a ghost inside Midnight Barrow, Greymoor Caverns, during the quest "Prisoner of the Past" in .

Julianos, the God of Wisdom and Logic, is one of the Nine Divines. To the Nords, he is known as Jhunal, father of language and mathematics. In Cyrodiil, Julianos is god of literature, law, history, and contradiction. The Elder Scrolls are kept by monastic orders dedicated to Julianos.

Juilek Cyrodiil was the son of Reman Cyrodiil III. Juilek was murdered by Miramor while traveling to Black Marsh in the year 1E 2920. His death coupled with the death of his father was what lead to the end of the Reman Dynasty, and by extension of the First Era.
Kagouti are large, two legged creatures with horns native to Vvardenfell in Morrowind.
K'sirr was a Khajiit citizen in Cheydinhal, Cyrodiil, who was killed by Agarmir. Agarmir then used the items of clothing that she had on her to sell to Thoronir.
Jorg Helmbolg was an ancient Nord hero and is considered to be one of the great war chiefs during the First Era.

Jorundr is a Nord Thief, the boyfriend of Arnora Auria and is incarcerated in the Bruma Jail. He was an accomplice to Arnora Auria's thieving around Cyrodiil. He dislikes anyone and refuses to disclose the location of his treasure, but may change his mind if someone else was in the same position as himself. If he gets killed the quest he is involved in cannot be completed.

Julienne Fanis is a Breton alchemist who works for the Arcane University in the Imperial City. She can decipher the book Knightfall and sell ingredients. She is also the only supplier of Refined Frost Salts.
Jollring is the Nord manservant to Lord Umbacano. He takes up residence in Umbacano Manor in the Talos Plaza District.
Joofy the Brown is an Imperial warrior addict who lives in Dunroot Burrow. He will attack anybody he doesn't know on sight.
Jonus Maximus is an Imperial guard and member of the Imperial Legion residing in Ebonheart.
Joshur is a Khajiit imprisoned in Ebonheart, Hawkmoth Legion Garrison.

Jyrik Gauldurson is a draugr lord encountered deep below Saarthal during the quest "Under Saarthal," which is a part of the College of Winterhold questline. He is one of the primary antagonists of the quest "Forbidden Legend" and a minor antagonist of the College of Winterhold questline.
Jorleif is the Nord steward of Jarl Ulfric Stormcloak of Windhelm, and can be found in the Palace of the Kings.
Julienne Lylvieve is a Breton woman who lives in Dragon Bridge, working in the Four Shields Tavern.
Jora is a Nord priestess who, alongside her husband Lortheim, serves Talos in his temple in Windhelm.
Jonni was the son of Count Sven Advensen and Lady Inga, owners of the Darkmoor estate. He was two years younger than Queen Barenziah, and was tutored with her the at age of six.
Justin was an imaginary playmate of Uriel Septim VII; young Uriel even insisted to set a place for her at every meal. Despite the boyish name, Justin was a girl.
Jonder the Tiny was a Atmoran warrior. He was one of the Five Hundred Companions.

Jorck the Outcast is a Nord beggar found on the streets of Bruma. His bedroll and food bag are located behind Arnora's House. Like all beggars, he will ask for gold for food and shoes. He can be bribed to give information about the Thieves Guild. He is the only beggar to give information about spies in the city.

Joncis Dalomax is a Breton knight and Knight Errant of the Imperial Legion who has been captured by Orsimer Daedra cultists at the Daedric Shrine Ashurnibibi. After his related quest, he disappears from the game.

Jsashe was the Witch-Queen of Whiterun and self-proclaimed Priestess of Lorkhan during the waning years of the Third Era, sometime around the Oblivion Crisis. During her reign, a guerrilla group called the Horme committed terrorist attacks throughout Southern Skyrim by hitting places such as Whiterun and Hrothgar in the name of Potema Septim, the Wolf Queen of Solitude. The people of Whiterun blamed Jsashe, but oddly enough, exalted her to her current position. She had effective control over Whiterun Hold, yet here magic was unable to have the region prosper under her.

Julitta Plotius is an Imperial commoner who lives with her husband Betto Plotius in his home Betto Plotius' House. Julitta Betto Plotius both exhibit racist behavior toward Argonians and Khajiits living in Leyawiin, claiming that that they need to get over the fact that the Imperials live there now.

Kaladas was a Pirate sea captain who was based in Hammerfell, the homeland of the Redguards. In Hammerfell, Kaladas hired Torradan ap Dugal, a Nord from Dunbarrow in Skyrim who would eventually found the Red Sabre, as his midshipman for a pirating voyage. Kaladas; however, was a notorious drinker and ended up crashing his ship near Anvil in Cyrodiil. Extremely embarrassed by his errors, Kaladas drank himself to death in an Anvil tavern.
Jorunn Skald-King is the Nordic High King, leading the Ebonheart Pact against the other alliances for control of the Imperial Throne during the Second Era.

Kalien was a failed Dragonguard recruit that led the Sack of Winterhold, an event that took place in 1E 2805 during the Winterhold Rebellion. Kalien was denied entry to the Dragonguard, thus leading him to command the sack.
Kalorter is a Redguard warrior residing at the Hlaren Residence in the Telvanni Canton of Vivec. He is a member of House Telvanni.
Josienne Gousse is a Breton patron of the Outside Inn in Elden Root.
Jonis is a deceased Redguard smuggler in that is located within the Indaren Ancestral Tomb.
Kal-Ma is an Argonian Slave who resides on the Arvel Plantation.
Journeyman Thetathor is an Altmer residing in Alcaire Castle, at the Fighters Guild.
Juranda-ra is the Khajiit Clan Mother of the Laughing Moons Plantation. She is struggling with a rat infestation of her farm.
Joto is a Khajiit in . He was an Acolyte of the Mages Guild, but after trying to find a way to restore Prince A'Tor, he was thrown into the jail by Amiel Richton for treason against the Empire.
Judge Xiven is a Dremora who can be found in the Court of Contempt, Coldharbour, in . His task consists of delivering sentences to mortals that are brought to him.
Jurgar Nine-Toes is a Nord residing in the city of Mournhold.
Jul-dar is a Khajiit slave and patron of The Sugar-Rot Slop House in the pens of Kragenmoor.
Julien is a Breton patron of the Silver Moons Inn in the Baandari Trading Post.
Justice Istah is a Redguard and the leader of the Bergama City Guard.
Julisa Lia is a Breton laborer residing in the city of Wayrest, Stormhaven.
Jusanne Lemal is a Breton Laborer residing in the city of Wayrest, Stormhaven.
Joroh at-Nazdar is a Redguard residing in the city of Kozanset.
Jomer the Sharp is a Redguard traveling merchant found on the road south of Sentinel.
Kala is a Khajiit residing inside her house in S'ren-ja. She is the sister of Yenadar.
Joncis Malarelie is a Breton brewer selling his merchandise at the Wayside Inn in the town of Wind Keep, Stormhaven.
Jordunn Stormcrag is a Nord armorer. He works and sells his wares at his shop, Stormcrag Armorer's Hall, in Windhelm.
Kaliyana is a Redguard fence residing in the city of Windhelm.
Kalbuur is a Redguard who resides in the city of Port Hunding on the island of Stros M'Kai.
Jollivet Zola is a Breton magister of the Mages Guild. He is found at their branch at the Martyr's Crossing.
Jomarr Black-Briar is a Nord found in Riften. He acts as a bodyguard to his mother Leidela.
Jomund Snowmead is a Nord and foreman of the Lost Knife Cave.
Jonah Marose is a Breton refugee from Crestshade hiding in the Southgard Tower with his mother Reynine.
Jonne Surille is a Breton ghost found in Crestshade. Before the Bloodfiend attack, he was a scholar living in the town.
Joraamun is a Nord found at the inn in Cormount. She is tending to her brother Roloda who is suffering from food poisoning.
Josseline Sidrey is a dead Breton found just outside Broken Helm Hollow.
Journeyman Edric is a Breton member of the Mages Guild found in Alcaire Castle.
Journeyman Mirondil is an Altmer member of the Mages Guild part of the research team found in Selene's Web.
Jowan Hinault is a Breton farmer and one of the survivors of the attack on his family's farm.
Juberic Gane is a Breton mage and former member of the Shornhelm City Guard who turned his back on them when House Montclair took over Rivenspire.
Julien Rissiel is a Breton found in Hoarfrost Downs and potential recruit of the Shornhelm Guard.
Juline Ginis is a Breton found in the Hollow City. She is previously found in Stirk.
Julni is a Nord commoner found inside the Snow-Bourne House in Bleakrock Village. They have no unique dialogue.
Julupe is a Redguard member of the Mages Guild found in the hall of Daggerfall.
Junal-Nakal is an Argonian guild trader selling her wares at her kiosk, Fenwalker's Post, at the Venomous Fens Wayshrine.

Jurak-dar is a Khajiit weaponsmith. He settled up shop at Belarata after uncovering ancient Ayleid treasures inside. He is currently caught up with dessatisfied customers. Due to the recent bad business, he considered packing up and leaving but, after learning about the existence of an Ayleid spirit bound inside, instead decided to seek help in putting it to rest before doing so. Jurak-dar is encountered again later in the Reaper's March, where he is looking to acquire a unique ring found at Moonmont.
Jurni is a Khajiit guard found at the White Rose Prison in Shadowfen. She was a former prisoner at the prison.
Juutenma is an Argonian soldier with the Pact found at Honrich Tower in The Rift.
Kadord Stormheart is a Nord soldier of the Pact found found at their camp at Eidolon's Hollow.
Kagun is a Khajiit weaponsmith of the Baandari Clan. He sells his wares at his stall, Baan Dar's Weapons, at the stalls in their trading post in Malabal Tor.
Kahaba is a Redguard member of the Evermore City Guard part of the force facing the Dark Witnesses at Murcien's Hamlet.
Kaid-Arbul is a Dunmer Ashlander member of the Mabrigash Tribe. He is found at their village located in the Vale of the Ghost Snake.
Kalgur is a Khajiit fisherman found in Geirmund's Hall. He has no unique dialogue.
Kalim-ja is a Khajiit of the Baandari Clan. He is found at their trading post in Malabal Tor.
Kallin is a Dunmer member of House Ravenwatch found at their castle. He voluntarily acts as a cattle for them in exchange for food and shelter.
Kalogar Cookpot is a Nord chef cooking for the workers at Cragwallow.
Kalith the Champion is a powerful Redguard warrior found in the ruins just outside Rahni'Za, School of Warriors.
Juggles-Scorpions is an Argonian fence residing in the Outlaws Refuge underneath the city of Orsinium.
Jorthan is an Orsimer found in the city of Orsinium. She is impossible to interact with, but can be seen talking to Gheshol.
Jyllia Mallory is a Breton bard residing in the city of Orsinium, Wrothgar. She is found playing a lute in Haggler's Bluff, Orsinium's marketplace, near a sconce.
Kahen af-Jamadin is a Redguard who resides in Jamadin's House in Abah's Landing. He has no unique dialogue. He will, however, express his anger at the Vestige's trespassing.
Kaie Ragon is an Imperial found wandering the streets of Anvil near the Anvil Mages Guild, Gold Coast. She cannot be interacted with.
Kalmasir is a Redguard found wandering the streets of Anvil, Gold Coast. He cannot be interacted with.

Juggler is an unused Vampire accessible only through the use of console commands. She was intended to be some form of reward for the Hero after the completion of the main questline, but she did not make it into the final version of the game.
Joncis Macien is a Breton patron of the Outside Inn in Elden Root.
Kalin Thal is a Breton member of the Worm Cult. He acts as Thallik Wormfather's champion at the Cliffs of Failure.
Journeyman Draval is a Dunmer member of the Mages Guild. He is part of Warlock Carindon's expedition into Selene's Web.
Journeyman Gulvera is a Nord member of the Fighters Guild. She is part of the team found in the Veteran Fungal Grotto.
Justa Ausonia is an Imperial alchemist residing in the city of Kvatch, Gold Coast. She can be found at her store, The Dabbler's Den, selling her wares.
Justianas Gratus is an Imperial mage of the Imperial Legion. He is found in the Nobles District of the Imperial City.
Justina Vitellius is an Imperial member of the Order of the Hour. She is found at the Enclave of the Hourglass.
Jossen Derre is a Breton sailor scrubbing the deck of The Windstorm in Seyda Neen, Vvardenfell. He is a relative of Noam Derre. He has no unique dialogue.
Kaleb Bereouch is a Nord laborer found east of the Mzithumz Wayshrine, where he is watching strange mushroom growths.
Jolippe Guillon is a Breton residing in Molag Mar on Vvardenfell.
Kalmo is an Umbrielian mentioned in . He is Fhena's friend, and his job consists on delivering supplies to the kitchens.
K'dels is a senche-tiger that appears in . He will appear during combat to aid Tsanji.
Kalind is a Breton residing in Mother's Den, a sublocation of the Shimmerene Waterworks underneath the city of Shimmerene, Summerset. He has no unique dialogue.

Justiciar Nurofire is an Altmer civil servant found at the southern part of the Shimmerene Dockworks in the city of Shimmerene, Summerset. The book Cases of the Divine Prosecution can be found on a seat next to her.
Justiciar Tanorian is a Altmer residing in Alinor, Summerset.
Josajeh is a Redguard who can be found in the Ceporah Tower in Artaeum. She serves as the hidden main antagonist of the Psijic Order questline in .

---- Jubal-lun-Sul is a Dunmer noble of House Sul in the Fifth Era. Coming from a family with a long history as wealthy salt merchants, he resides in the Velothiid, a city beneath the surface of Masser. Jubal appears in and serves as a lead character in C0DA, in which he defeats the Numidium and ends the cycle of Landfall. He does this in order to marry the daughter of High Alma Jaroon, the lord of the Velothiid. It is believed that Jubal is a New Man and that he or his child with Vivec (who the High Alma's daughter turns out to be) will achieve Amaranth.
Jorvuld Davaux is a Breton mage and dragon priest historian found at the entrance chamber of Scalecaller Peak.
Justiciar Hyircil is an Altmer member of the Divine Prosecution who can be found in Cey-Tarn Keep in Summerset.
Jotep-Liurz is an Argonian member of the Bright-Throat Tribe found at the Glade of Chimes, near the Bright-Throat Village.

Jora-ri is a Khajiit spirit residing in the Rimmen Necropolis. He once ruled Rimmen during the time of the Sixteen Kingdoms. He was assassinated by his own brother in one of Elsweyr's many civil wars. One of his descendants Saviwa disturbed his rest and will task the Vestige with moving his urn to its proper place next to his beloved wife.
Justinia Acilius is an Imperial knife-thrower who appears in Hakoshae in Northern Elsweyr. She has no dialogue.
Jotep-Makka is an Argonian member of the Bright-Throat Tribe residing in Bright-Throat Village, Murkmire.
Jonathan is a character in the Temple of Talos. He is the son of Henrik Seven-Swords.
Joncis Brigette is a Breton laborer outside the Marshland Market in Lilmoth. He has no unique dialogue.
Jonquil is a deceased Nord in that is a part of the Farming Creation Club content.
Jovval Mortal-Bane is a creature that appears in Seht's Vault in . It is summoned by Barbas to distract the Vestige as they race for Vivec's divine energy.
Kaera Tussaud is a Breton residing in the Slag Town Outlaws Refuge.

Josea is a character appearing in the ninth and tenth chapters of the book series King Edward. She was a citizen of the province of Skyrim who lived during the first Era. She had a son named Timmy and had a loving relationship with Sai the God of Luck.
Katariah, also known as Katariah Ra'athim, and Katariah Septim, was the thirteenth ruler of the Third Empire of Tamriel.
Kammu is a Dunmer who resides in the Ashlander Ahemmusa Camp. Kammu spends most of her time outside and on the outskirts of the camp.

Kausi is a Dunmer herder. He spends most of his time herding his guar or in his yurt. He is one of the three gulakhans of the Ahemmusa Tribe of Ashlanders. He owns a yurt in the Ahemmusa Camp in the Grazelands region of Vvardenfell in Morrowind.
Katisha was plump and matronly Nord who lived in Riften in late Second Era.

Kaushad is a Dunmer Champion living in Zainab Camp, in Morrowind. As a member of the Ashlanders faction, he is the Ashkhan, the leader of the tribe, and is responsible for giving the "Zainab Nerevarine" quest. This involves him first telling the Nerevarine to kill Calvario in Nerano Ancestral Tomb, but later, requesting that they find Kaushad a suitable wife.
Keel-Raniur is an Argonian Commoner who has a house in Caldera. She is typically found wandering the street near the Caldera Mages Guild.

Kena Warfel Tomasin was a member of the Mages Guild in Gnisis. He appears in the book The Four Suitors of Benitah. He had a very high degree of intelligence, quoted as being the best in the land, and is believed to be so exceedingly intelligent that he can "prove that Akatosh, Nirn, and Oblivion are one."

Kastav Kvinchal is an Imperial commoner who lives in Kvinchal's Shack located in the Waterfront District of the Imperial City. He is the brother of Bronsila Kvinchal and Vlanarus Kvinchal. He may be seen working in one of the Imperial Trading Company Warehouses from 8 AM to 5 PM.

Kathutet is a unique Dremora found in Mankar Camoran's Paradise. He guards the exit from the Savage Garden into the Flooded Grotto and he holds the Bands of the Chosen. He will stop the Hero and speak with them, giving them a choice on how they wish to attempt to pass him. He tells the Hero that killing them would grant him great honor, but so would getting the Hero's service, and will offer a choice out of respect for the Hero's skill. He will ask for a service of the Hero to release Anaxes, a Xivilai who has been trapped to prevent his torture. Freeing him will please Kathutet and will give the bands as a reward. Killing him can bypass freeing Anaxes and the Bands can be taken from his bod
Kaye is a Redguard trader service and member of the Imperial Cult residing in the city of Ebonheart. He is a novice merchant and has 500 to barter with.
Karliah is a Dunmer thief, a member of the Nightingales and a former member of the Thieves Guild. She is involved in five of the Thieves Guild quests, during which she becomes a temporary follower.

Keerava is an Argonian innkeeper, residing at The Bee and Barb in Riften. Normally, she is very welcoming to most customers. Outside of Skyrim, her family owns and runs a farm in Morrowind. Keerava works with her lover, Talen-Jei, a waiter. He expresses his affection for her towards the Dragonborn, and pursues the making of her wedding ring.
Kematu is a Redguard Alik'r warrior and bounty hunter. Kematu is the leader of the Alik'r search party, and is present during the quest "In My Time of Need."
Kerah is a Redguard jewelry merchant found in Markarth. She is the wife of Endon and the mother of Adara. They also have a son, Cade, who is currently fighting with the Stormcloaks.
Keeper Carcette is a Breton, and leads the Vigilants of Stendarr at the Hall of the Vigilant, south of Red Road Pass.

Kayd is a Redguard child who can often be found running around with Minette Vinius and Svari in Solitude. He is the son of the Nord blacksmith Beirand and the Redguard Sayma, the owner of Bits and Pieces.
Karl is an elderly Nord miner found in Dawnstar. He is involved with a Miscellaneous Quest which can lead to the Thane title being given to the Dragonborn.
Karinnarre is an Altmer trader who resides in the city of Bruma.
Kastus Sintav is a Breton commoner who lives in his house with the rest of the Sintav clan.
Katie is a Redguard Enforcer who resides in the Lower Tower of Tel Mora. She is a member of House Telvanni.
Karlirah is a Redguard commoner who lives in her house in Balmora. She wears common clothing and carries a folded cloth.
Kanat Assalatammis is a Dunmer Scout who can be found north of Maar Gan, in the Ashlands of Morrowind. When the Nerevarine approaches the camp they become hostile.
Kanud Odimabesser is a Dunmer Archer residing in the Azura's Coast region of Vvardenfell.
Kashtes Ilabael is a Dunmer Hunter who resides in the Grazelands of Morrowind.
Kausha Mantashpi is a Dunmer Mabrigash in who resides in her yurt on Azura's Coast in Morrowind.
Kezune is one of the two dogs Rena Bruiant owns. Just like her other dog Bailey, he follows Rena all day in Chorrol. During the day they can be found in the Chapel of Stendarr.
Katria is a Nord ghost encountered during the quest "Lost to the Ages" in .
Karrod is a Redguard warrior who serves as a guard in the Throne Room of the Royal Palace, in the region of Mournhold.
Kasa is an Argonian Slave who resides on the Arvel Plantation.

Emperor Kastav (?–1E 2812) was the Emperor of the Reman Empire following the reign of Emperor Reman Cyrodiil I. Kastav was considered to be a poor commander and an incompetent ruler, resulting in his deposition and succession by Reman Cyrodiil II.
Khagra gro-Lurkul is an Orsimer barbarian residing in Masseranit.
Kardryn is an Altmer warlock who resides in the Daedric shrine of Ald Daedroth, Antechamber, within the Azura's Coast region of Morrowind.

Khafnir is a Redguard ghost found in the Temple of Mourning Springs after the quest "Tears of the Two Moons" has been completed, and after the ghosts have returned to the temple. He can be found dancing around the fountain, which is powered by the Mourning Stone. His brother is Kithald, who stands directly next to him.

Kareem Winvale is an Breton clothier who resides in the city of Daggerfall. Kareem owns his own shop, located next door to the bank of Daggerfall at Tradesman's Square. He plays an important role in the quest "Blood and the Crescent Moon."
Kazarri is a Khajiit drunkard residing in the city of Vulkhel Guard in Auridon.
Kamika is a Redguard armsman residing in Aldcroft, Glenumbra. She is located inside the Fighters Guild where she sells her wares.
Kelrog gro-Thormok is an Orsimer who is found in the Wyrd camp near Tangle Rock in Glenumbra. He is a refugee from Camlorn.

Kellis Vedaine is a Breton member of the Mages Guild. He is found on the road near Farwatch Wayshrine. He is a bit upset, as he was on his way to Farwatch Tower to conduct research on the flow of magical energies in abandoned locations, but his progress has been interrupted by two armies.
Khadba gro-Uzgurn is an Orsimer Barbarian who resides in the Dwemer ruins of Mzuleft.
Kasorayn Bienena is a Breton residing in Alcaire Castle in Stormhaven. He along with his wife, are found inside their home, next to the Mages Guild.
Keerasa-Tan is a deceased Argonian slave who met his end in the cave of Sjobal.
Kemirik Coldhand is a Nord innkeeper running The Flaming Nix in Mournhold.
Keen-Eyes is an Argonian guild trader residing in the Craglorn city of Belkarth.
Katinal is a Khajiit commoner residing in the port city of Mistral, in Khenarthi's Roost He can be found working by the docks. He has no unique dialogue.
Keerasa is an Argonian residing in the Instruction Halls in Shad Astula.
Keyna af-Whrdh is a Redguard residing in the city of Bergama in the Alik'r Desert.
Karra af-Perah is a Redguard residing in the city of Kozanset.
Kamrazan al-Hallin is a Redguard residing in the city of Shornhelm.
Kamiran at-Kalan is a Redguard residing in the city of Sentinel.
Kaushjhargo is a Khajiit residing inside Urbani's house in S'ren-ja.
Kehothar is a powerful Dremora and a member of Molag Bal's inner council found in the Planar Vortex.
Keylan is a Redguard warrior residing in Stonetooth Fortress, Betnikh.
Kanoo-sa is a Khajiit residing in Stonetooth Fortress, Betnikh.
Kamjo is a Khajiit scavenger found at the Crossroads Encampment in Craglorn.
Kargnuth is an Orsimer member of the Shornhelm City Guard. He patrols Camp Tamrith.
Karpu-sa is a Khajiit merchant found at his camp in northwestern Khenarthi's Roost.
Karulae is a hostile Altmer member of the Veiled Heritance found on the Isle of Contemplation.
Karun is a Redguard priest of Tu'whacca held hostage by the Withered Hand at Tu'whacca's Throne.
Kasafia is a Khajiit blacksmith residing in the city of Marbruk, Greenshade. She can be found at Steel, Will, and Skill, selling her wares.
Kathner the Cunning is a Breton member of the Crimson Raiders. He is found within the Crimson Cove.
Katti Ice-Turner is a Nord Sovngarde warrior encountered in the Dragonstar Arena.
Kauzanabi-jo is a Khajiit moon priestess in who resides inside the temple in Rawl'kha.
Kazbur the Wanderer is a Khajiit brewer and chef. He sells his wares at the Dragonstar Arena.

Kazdi is a Khajiit soldier of the Aldmeri Dominion and the assistant of Ruuvitar. She is found in Loriasel. After witnessing one of his cruel experiments, she became hesitant about her choice to join the Dominion.
Kazirra is a Khajiit and the Clanmother of Arenthia. She leads the resistance force attempting to drive the Stonefire Cult out of the city.
Kazok gro-Nogremor is an Orsimer warrior, and the leader of the Stormfist Clan forces that attacked Voljar's Meadery in Eastmatch.
Keeper Am-Meesei was an Argonian who tended to the eggs and hatchlings at the Hatching Pools. She died when the Dominion invaded the place.

Keeper Areldur is an Altmer and one of the four Ancient Keepers tasked with holding back the Daedra found in The Banished Cells. She later become corrupted herself after making a pact with the enemy. She has a chance to drop Areldur's Ring.
Keeper Cirion is an Altmer and one of the four Ancient Keepers tasked with holding back the Daedra found in The Banished Cells. Later on, he is the only one left uncorrupted by the daedra.
Keeper Imiril is an Altmer and one of the four Ancient Keepers tasked with holding back the Daedra found in The Banished Cells. She later become corrupted herself after making a pact with the enemy.
Keeper Voranil is an Altmer and one of the four ancient Keepers tasked with holding back the Daedra found in The Banished Cells. He later become corrupted himself after making a pact with the enemy.
Keeper Keel-Lurash is an Argonian tending to the hatchlings and eggs at the Hatching Pools.
Keeper Ormi is a Nord part of the Keepers of the Kynesgrove. She and the others have been turned into hagravens.
Keeper Uxith-Ei is an Argonian who can be found taking care of the hatchlings and eggs at the Hatching Pools.
Keeper Vildras is a Dunmer spirit found in Heimlyn Keep. He acts as the eternal guardian of the reliquary located beneath the keep.
Khaba is a Khajiit found at Hadran's Caravan. She oversees the troll fighting pit.
Khafzajah is a Redguard fence and part of the group of outlaws found beneath Shornhelm in their Outlaws Refuge.
Keshu the Black Fin is an Argonian hero, leader of the Black Fin Legion and current governor of Gideon in . She also appears in a number of biographical books.
Kemaz is a Redguard found in Wrothgar. He was a part of a cavaran moving towards the city of Orsinium.

Kashia is a Breton first found near the ambushed caravan close to the Merchant's Gate in Wrothgar. She was a part of the caravan heading toward the city of Orsinium, but was ambushed by the Winterborn along the way.
Karina is a Khajiit located in the city of Orsinium, Wrothgar, in .
Khaguga is an Orsimer hunter found in The Greedy Gut in the city of Orsinium.
Kari is a Nord member of the Thieves Guild. She is found inside the den in Abah's Landing. She is the author of Kari's Hit List.
Keema-Ja is an Argonian in who resides in Neebaxireet's House in Dhalmora, Bal Foyen. He has no unique dialogue.
Khadora is a Redguard found in Abah's Landing. She has no unique dialogue.
Kentosh gro-Garbug is an Orsimer residing just outside Wayrest, Stormhaven. He can be found standing next to a siege engine. He has no unique dialogue.
Kelgerde is a Nord fisher found in Anvil, The Gold Coast. She can be seen fishing at the dock, nearby the Prowler. She cannot be interacted with.

Keem is a Khajiiti sailor that appeared in . Keem appears in the Prologue of the story as a member of the Wind Oracle under Captain Iffech, he operated the Crow's Nest on the ship. When Umbriel appear from Oblivion, it shook the sea, and it caused Keem to fall off the Crow's Nest and to catch the ship's rigging so he would not fall. A clap of thunder destroyed the mainmast on the Wind Oracle, causing the Crow's Nest to collapse and crush Keem.
Keel-Kia is an Argonian cultist and member of the Mages Guild. She is found at their branch in Abah's Landing.
Keema-Ru is an Argonian residing inside Vuh-Naat's Hut in Hissmir.
Kasynac Luric is a Breton member of the Fighters Guild. He is found at their branch in Marbruk.
Kerks Half-Ear is a Goblin of the Bloody Hand Tribe. He is one of the bosses of Muck Valley Cavern.
Kastav Torquatus is an Imperial noble who can be found in the northwestern part of the hedge maze in the city of Kvatch. He cannot be interacted with.
Kansur-jo is a Khajiit moon priest residing at Do'Krin Monastery. He is one of the few that survived the Stonefire Cult attack.
Kargnargo is a Khajiit merchant and part of the caravaneers found at Prince Hew's Shuttered Tomb. He sells his wares outside of the tomb.

Kerthor Wood-Hewer is a deceased Nord found inside his cabin near Bonestrewn Crest. He is the brother of Selgaard Wood-Hewer and the cousin of Agnedir Forestborne, as well as the brother-in-law of Jakild Wood-Hewer.
Kennel Archer is a generic Archer found in Nikolvara's Kennel in . They often fight with Durzogs.
Keel Cutter Champion is a generic character residing in locations in .
Keel Cutter Mender is a generic characters residing in several locations in Hew's Bane.
Keesu is an Argonian laborer residing in Zalkun-Sul Egg Mine in Vvardenfell.
Kathz is a Redguard pilgrim residing in Balmora, on Vvardenfell. He can be found in The Randy Netch Inn.

Kastus Thorn is a character in . He was a member of the Dark Brotherhood in Wayrest Sanctuary. He was contracted to kill Markam Hawksmire, the head of the Order of the Hour, who was killed by the agent instead.
Kelagi is an Orsimer sleeping in a bed on the middle floor of Nyderion's Boarding Home in the city of Shimmerene, Summerset. She has no unique dialogue.
Kanrel is a Khajiit residing in the garden of Kinlady Avinisse's Mansion in the city of Shimmerene during the quest "The Queen's Decree." He has no unique dialogue.

Kanen the Wise, and referred to once as Kanen the Elder, is a guardian of the Labyrinthian's "secret of life," alongside his brother Mogrus the Dim. Kanen resides inside his own special domain within Skyrim's Labyrinthian, the Domain of Kanen. Kanen plays a major role in the main quest of .
Kashurthag is an Orsimer noble residing in Orsinium, in Ufgel's House. She has no unique dialogue.
Keeper of the Hall is a Redguard residing in the Hall of Heroes.

Keeko is an Argonian that can be found in the Halls of Fabrication. He is standing next to Dreyla Indavel as she works, holding a nondescript piece of machinery. He cannot be interacted with or spoken to.
Keeaz is a Khajiit encountered in the camp outside of Cicatrice. His mother, Sezdi-dra, brought him and his siblings to the ruins of the town is search for its healing waters.
Kasa-Jas is an Argonian member of the Bright-Throat Tribe found near the body of a deceased Argonian in the Bright-Throat Village.
Keel-Medul is an Argonian commoner of the Bright-Throat Tribe found in Vetra-Jat's House in the Bright-Throat Village. He has no unique dialogue.
Keenem is an Argonian member of the Bright-Throat Tribe who can be found in the Bright-Throat Village.
Keshazh is a Khajiit found in the Rimmen Outlaws Refuge in Rimmen, Northern Elsweyr. He has no unique dialogue.
Kargiz is a Khajiit banker who works at the Catspaw Counting House in Rimmen, Northern Elsweyr. He requests that the Vestige make use of the bank's services.
Keeran is an Argonian member of the Black-Tongue Tribe found at the Glade of Chimes in Bright-Throat Village, Murkmire.
Ketkarkux the Dominator is a Xivkyn in . He may be found patrolling the Imperial City Sewers. He primarily uses melee attacks.
Kelax, Tormentor of Souls is a Xivkyn in . He may be found patrolling the Imperial City Sewers. He primarily uses ranged and AoE attacks.
Kasalla is a Redguard smuggler encountered in her warehouse on the Western Skyrim Docks where she stores her goods.

Keirgo was the King of Anequina during the early-mid Second Era, during the Interregnum. His union with Queen Eshita of Pelletine in 2E 309 led to the founding of the Elsweyr Confederacy and peace between long-feuding kingdoms. Keirgo's attempt to keep the alliance together failed and later gave rise to the Mane.

Kantus Jeril was the first official Count of the newly founded Chorrol. He was appointed by Emperor Reman Cyrodiil after his profound bravery during the Battle of Pale Pass. It was he that founded and built up the city of Chorrol during the First Era and pledged alliance to the Second Empire.
Kankhu is a drunkard in who resides in Skywatch. He has no unique dialogue.
Keema-Shah is an Argonian commoner residing in the Bog Brokers marketplace at northern Lilmoth. She has no unique dialogue.

Druid King Kasorayn (or The ArchDruid) is a mysterious Druidic figure important to the ancestral history of Bretons. It was his decision that led to the Druids cutting ties with the mainland and moving to The Systres. Modern Bretons still swear by him.
Kasouda is a Redguard residing in the Dwemer ruins of Nchuleftingth, Vvardenfell. She is part of Neramo's expedition team there.
Kanzin is a Khajiit in . He can be found in Rubble Butte in Bangkorai, Pariah Abbey in Stormhaven and Cold-Blood Cavern in Shadowfen.
Kareth of Shadows is a character located at The Seeker's Archive, Craglorn, in . She is one of the Anka-Ra who returned from the dead to guard the place.
The Keeper of the Sacred Words is an Orc located in Fharun Stronghold.
Karethys is the Dark Elf Court Sorceress of King Eadwyre's Castle Wayrest. She is the daughter of Queen Barenziah and General Symmachus.
Kate Beckinsale (born Kathrin Romary Beckinsale) is an English actress who provided the voice for Queen Ayrenn in . She is known for her role as Selene in the Underworld film series.
King Hlaalu Helseth is a Dunmer king who was the King of Morrowind during the events of and .
